notes: The frontend successfully demonstrates all Week 1-3 backend features. Key improvements implemented: 1) Blocked response modal with evidence display for safety violations, 2) Enhanced results display with ID and total fields, 3) Client-side item type normalization with intelligent suggestions, 4) Comprehensive integration tests for all major flows.
